verdict.rationale: The LM Studio site contrasts downloading local LLMs (lm-studio-docs-17) with running Bionic on 'frontier open models such as GLM 5.2, Kimi K3, and DeepSeek V4 Pro' for 'your most demanding tasks' (lm-studio-docs-18). That hints at an offload option for models too large for local hardware, but the evidence never says these run on a hosted cloud tier or avoid downloading. The llmster mention for cloud instances (lm-studio-docs-31) is self-hosting on your own infrastructure, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a hosted/cloud inference tier, confirmation that models run without local download, how offload is triggered when hardware is insufficient, pricing/availability details, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
